units.source_text: 却说中将源氏公子做了一个离奇古怪的梦，便召唤占梦人前来，叫他详梦。

en.t: Now Prince Genji, the lieutenant general, had a strange and uncanny dream, so he summoned a dream interpreter and asked him to explain it in detail.

units.source_text: 岂知判语是公子所意想不到的怪事[\[22\]](#part1334.html#m22)。

en.t: Unexpectedly, the interpretation spoke of a strange matter that the prince had never imagined[\[22\]](#part1334.html#m22).

units.source_text: 那占梦人又说：“此福缘中含有凶相，必须谨防。”

en.t: The dream interpreter also said, "Within this fortunate bond there is an ominous sign, so you must be very cautious."

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得此事不妙，便对占梦人说：“这不是我做的梦，是别人做的梦。

en.t: Prince Genji felt that this was troubling, and said to the interpreter, "This was not my dream; it was someone else's dream.

units.source_text: 在你的判语尚未应验之前，决不可向外人宣扬！”

en.t: Before your interpretation has come true, you must absolutely not spread it to anyone outside!"

units.source_text: 他心中却想：“到底是怎么一回事？”

en.t: Yet in his heart he wondered, "What on earth can this mean?"
From then on, his mind was uneasy.

units.source_text: 后来听到了藤壶妃子怀孕的消息，方才悟道：“原来那梦所暗示的是这件事！”

en.t: Later, when he heard the news that Lady Fujitsubo was pregnant, he finally understood: "So this is what that dream was hinting at!"

units.source_text: 他觉得更加恋恋不舍，便千言万语地嘱托王命妇，要和妃子再见一面。

en.t: His longing grew even harder to bear, and he pleaded with Omyobu again and again to let him see the lady once more.

units.source_text: 但王命妇想起了以往的事，心中异常恐惧。

en.t: But Omyobu remembered what had happened before, and was terribly afraid in her heart.

units.source_text: 况且今后行事更加困难，竟毫无办法。

en.t: Besides, arranging anything from then on would be even more difficult, and in the end there was no way to manage it.

units.source_text: 以前源氏公子还可偶尔得到妃子片言只语的回音，此后完全音信断绝了。

en.t: Before, Prince Genji had still occasionally received a brief word or two in reply from the lady, but after this all communication ceased completely.
